div.head: Af 27.1
div.ab: Gif he medrenmages nage, gilden ða gegilden healfne, ond for healfne he fleo.
Gif he medrenmægas nage, gielden þa gegildan healfne, for healfne he fleo.
Si nec maternam cognationem habeat, soluant congildones (eius) dimidiam compositionem, pro dimidia fugiat.
Gif he medrenmægas nage, gielden þa gegildan healfne, for healfne he fleo.
If he has no maternal kin, let the associates pay half, for half let him flee.
If he has no maternal relatives, his associates shall pay half [the wergeld], and in default of payment of the [other] half, he shall be held personally responsible.
If he has no maternal kinsmen, the associates are to pay half, and for half he is to flee.
Wenn er mütterliche Verwandte nicht besitzt, sollen die Gildengenossen den halben [Theil] zahlen; für den [anderen] halben fliehe er.
If he has no maternal kinsmen, let the guild-brothers pay half; for the [other] half let him flee.
div.note: Whitelock numbers this chapter 27.1 and gives Liebermann’s number, 27.1, in brackets.
